split.description: Four outer leave-one-original-Type-out folds, three inner remaining-Type folds; all 31 declared canonical blocks preserved. Not leave-one-experiment-out.

factors.name: Type
factors.relationship: Canonical blocks nested within original Type; Type/Scale source categories do not establish physical or experiment identity.

spectral_support.reference_population: Type A fold training population, excluding Type A
limitations: Two projections do not establish full spectral support; other contexts have their own summaries.

spectral_support.description: Qualified continuous support is explicitly unavailable in the source report.
limitations: Do not substitute a truncated-PCA moment estimate or interpret support as a risk probability.
One exploratory development population; unknown physical/assay dependencies prevent independent-generalization claims.
The existing pooled scores hide context variation; Type A has negative R2 and target-range extrapolation for both models.
Full-source X descriptors elsewhere in the source report have a different scope from train-fitted diagnostics; they did not select these models.
